    People also ask
    Is TNT on Peacock or Paramount?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    TNT is not available on Peacock or Paramount+
    . It is a cable channel owned by Warner Bros. Discovery and is best streamed live via services like DirecTV Stream, Hulu + Live TV, Sling TV, or YouTube TV. For on-demand content, TNT shows are typically found on Max. 
    Key Details on Accessing TNT: 
    • Live TV Streaming: Sling TV, Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, and DirecTV Stream carry the live TNT channel.
    • On-Demand: Max (formerly HBO Max) is the primary streaming home for Warner Bros. Discovery content, including TNT shows.
    • Not on Peacock/Paramount: Neither Peacock nor Paramount+ includes the live TNT channel in their lineups
      .
